public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle asynchronous chart-data responses before deriving labels**

When `GLOBAL_ASYNC_QUERIES` is enabled and the chart query is not cached, the default JSON/full request can return HTTP 202 with job metadata rather than chart data, as implemented in [Superset 6.1.0's chart-data endpoint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/superset/6.1.0/superset/charts/data/api.py). This expression discards the response status and converts the missing `result` into `[]`, so a populated pie or timeseries chart silently reports no labels; `dashboard_labels()` propagates that incorrect result. Retrieve the completed job's data before applying the label rules, or explicitly reject asynchronous responses instead of presenting them as empty chart results.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
